name: Basic Attack
summary: Standard melee attack.

name: Jester's Gambit
summary: Roll the cosmic dice. High variance chaos damage, boosted crit.

name: Taunt & Mock
summary: Insult so devastating it lowers defenses. Charisma scaling. QTE: English quiz.

name: Avalanche
summary: Yeti pulls down a slab of mountain. Massive AoE, knockback, leaves ice terrain.

name: Maul
summary: Devastating swipe that knocks the target back.

name: Terrifying Roar
summary: Roar that terrifies nearby enemies.

name: Charm Gaze
summary: Kumiho's gaze entrances the target — they cannot cast and take heightened damage.

name: Chill Wind
summary: Blast of freezing wind in a cone. Creates ice terrain.

name: Fire Swipe
summary: Fiery claw swipe. Basic melee attack of the chimera.

name: Flame Wave
summary: Cone of flame from the fire head. Burns and creates fire terrain.

name: Frost Breath
summary: Devastating breath from the ice head. Line AoE, heavy frostbite.

name: Climbing Leap
summary: Skitters over walls and obstacles to land beside the target. Ignores cover.

name: Demon Fire
summary: Hellish flame erupts around the Oni, burning everything nearby.

name: Ember Slash
summary: A fiery slash. Chance to burn.

name: Fox Fire
summary: Pale spirit-flame conjured from a tail. Cursed wound — prevents regen.

name: Frost Charge
summary: Frost Runner sprints and slams into a target. Closes the gap fast.

name: Frost Crush
summary: Two-handed frost-rotted slam. Deals double damage and breaks armor.

name: Frost Touch
summary: Gentle ice magic. Applies frostbite, slowing the target.

name: Healing Light
summary: Warm healing magic. Restores HP and grants regen.

name: Hunter's Strike
summary: Precise strike that marks the target, increasing damage taken.

name: Ice Shard
summary: Ranged ice projectile.

name: Ice Shield
summary: Creates an ice barrier on an ally that absorbs damage.

name: Oni Rage
summary: Wounded Oni roars in fury, gaining berserk damage and lashing out harder.

name: Kanabō Smash
summary: Two-handed iron club smash. Heavy knockback; crits stun.

name: Pack Howl
summary: Howl that empowers nearby wolves.

name: Phantom Tails
summary: Nine spectral tails lash out — multi-strike radius attack that bleeds targets.

name: Piercing Bolt
summary: Armor-piercing bolt that penetrates in a line. Reduces target DR.

name: Raise Frostling
summary: Necromancer hauls a fresh frost walker out of the snow. Adds another zombie to the field.

name: Rally
summary: Garr rallies the party. Buffs all allies' damage.

name: Snow Hurl
summary: Yeti hurls a packed boulder of snow and ice. Long range; slows the victim.

name: Suppressive Fire
summary: Spray of bolts in a cone. Lower damage but slows enemies. QTE: Mash!

name: Thunder Shot
summary: Bowy's signature crossbow shot. Long range, lightning element.

name: Set Trap
summary: Place a trap that creates a poison zone. Veteran hunting tactic.

name: Undying Chant
summary: Necromancer's dark chant — empowers and slowly heals all undead allies in range.

name: Walker Bite
summary: Frost-rotted teeth tear into flesh. Causes bleeding.

name: Frost Bite
summary: Freezing bite that chills to the bone.

name: Yeti Slam
summary: Yeti's two-fisted ground slam. Heavy knockback; crits stun targets cold.

name: Abomination Crush
summary: Two-fisted overhead crush. Ignores armor entirely and sends survivors flying.

name: Abomination Hurl
summary: Rips a chunk of rubble (or a corpse) free and hurls it across the battlefield. Splash on impact.

name: Ankle Bite
summary: Crawler latches onto a leg. Lower damage but slows and bleeds the target.

name: Corruption Pulse
summary: Necromancer pulses corruption from the beacon. Cursed wounds prevent healing.

name: Dark Bolt
summary: Necromancer's basic ranged spell. Bolt of negative energy.

name: Fatty Smash
summary: Belly-flop slam. The Fatty's full bloated weight comes down on the target.

name: Death Split
summary: On death, the Fatty bursts open — two fresh Walkers crawl out of the splash. (Triggered effect)

name: Raise Walker
summary: Necromancer pulls a fresh Walker out of the rot. Adds another zombie to the field.

name: Runner Pounce
summary: Sprint and tackle. Closes the gap fast and brings the target to the ground.

name: Toxic Bite
summary: Acid-bile bite. Heavy poison damage over time.

name: Toxic Burst
summary: On death, the Toxic Walker bursts. Poison cloud lingers in the area for several turns. (Triggered effect)

name: Walker Bite
summary: Rotting teeth tear into flesh. Causes bleeding.

name: Flare Shot
summary: Burnice snaps a burning flare into the target. Reliable ranged pressure that starts a small burn.

name: Burn Lane
summary: A controlled sweep of ignited accelerant across a choke point. Lower burst, better crowd control.

name: Flash Step
summary: A short jet-assisted sidestep into a snap shot. Leaves the target exposed for the next follow-up.
